Elon Musk Faces Lawsuits Over 2024 Election Lottery

Elon Musk has agreed to settle lawsuits concerning a 2024 election lottery. Musk founded America PAC, which supported Republican Donald Trump's 2024 presidential campaign. Separately, Musk has donated over $150 million to a Senate GOP group, reportedly assisting Ken Paxton. In other news, TSMC is exploring a role in Musk's proposed Texas chip complex.
